participant_id.Description: BIDS participant label (single patient of the case study)

source_id.Description: Patient code used in the release (SEEG84)

age.Description: Age of the patient. Not given in the Dryad release (ReadMe.txt, file names and sidecars checked) nor in the article abstract (PubMed 34775265); the full article (Bratu et al. 2021, Cortex 145:285-294, doi:10.1016/j.cortex.2021.08.018) is closed access and could not be read: n/a.

sex.Description: Sex of the patient. Not given in the Dryad release (ReadMe.txt, file names and sidecars checked) nor in the article abstract (PubMed 34775265); the full article (Bratu et al. 2021, Cortex 145:285-294, doi:10.1016/j.cortex.2021.08.018) is closed access and could not be read: n/a.

handedness.Description: Handedness of the patient. Not given in the Dryad release (ReadMe.txt, file names and sidecars checked) nor in the article abstract (PubMed 34775265); the full article (Bratu et al. 2021, Cortex 145:285-294, doi:10.1016/j.cortex.2021.08.018) is closed access and could not be read: n/a.

diagnosis.Description: Clinical diagnosis: 'a drug resistant epilepsy patient' explored with SEEG (Bratu et al. 2021, Cortex 145:285-294, doi:10.1016/j.cortex.2021.08.018, abstract; Dryad record abstract)

lesion.Description: Lesion covered by the implantation: 'electrodes covering the right posterior temporal PVNH and the adjacent cortex' (periventricular nodular heterotopia; Bratu et al. 2021, Cortex 145:285-294, doi:10.1016/j.cortex.2021.08.018, abstract)

implant_type.Description: Type of intracranial implantation (stereo-electroencephalography, depth electrodes; abstract; electrodes.tsv type=depth)

implanted_hemispheres.Description: Hemispheres with implanted contacts, from the hemisphere column of the authors' Contact_coordinates.xlsx (sub-01_space-Other_electrodes.tsv): 198 contacts on 13 right-hemisphere electrodes (I, A, B, F, L, D, Q, K, U, R, P, C, S) and 48 contacts on 3 left-hemisphere electrodes (X', Y', F')

n_electrodes.Description: Number of SEEG electrodes (shafts) with contact coordinates in the release (electrodes.tsv column group)

n_contacts.Description: Number of SEEG contacts with coordinates in the release (Contact_coordinates.xlsx -> electrodes.tsv)

stimulated_contacts.Description: Bipolar contact pair in the PVNH used for the 43 Hz and single-pulse stimulations (AnyWave markers '43Hz D08-D09 ...' and 'SPES D08 D09'; Dryad ReadMe: PVNH stimulation)
